p: dream: Their deliverance was incredible and therefore took away all excuse for ingratitude.
filled with laughter: He shows how the godly should rejoice when God gathers his Church or delivers it.
heathen: If the infidels confess God's wonderful work, the faithful can never show themselves sufficiently thankful.
streams in the south: It is no more impossible for God to deliver his people than to cause the rivers to run in the wilderness and barren places.
precious seed: That is, seed which was scarce and dear: meaning, that they who trusted in God's promise to return had their desire.
